jobs.title: Senior Photographer, E-Commerce Studio
jobs.content: Run the shoots of our fashion and home e-commerce studio: about 150 products a day with studio lighting, Capture One tethering and Photoshop retouching to our style guide. Senior role, six or more years of professional product or fashion photography. On-site in our Zurich studio, five days a week. English is our working language; German is helpful. Salary CHF 92,000 – 108,000 per year plus 13th month.

jobs.title: Product Photographer & Retoucher
jobs.content: Shoot and retouch products for our web shop: studio lighting, Capture One, Photoshop, colour-accurate files for print and web. Two to five years of experience. On-site in the Zurich studio. English is our working language in the studio; German is not required.

jobs.title: Editorial Photographer (60%)
jobs.content: Mid-level editorial photographer for a regional magazine: portraits, reportage and event coverage, about three assignments a week, picture editing from home or in our newsroom. Part-time, 60 percent. Hybrid. Working language English or German.

jobs.title: Junior Photographer (Trainee)
jobs.content: Your first photography job. Junior position for someone with up to two years of experience: assist on shoots, prepare equipment, sort and rate files under close guidance. On-site in Winterthur, five days a week. English is fine.

jobs.title: Fotograf:in (m/w/d), Deutsch erforderlich
jobs.content: Fotograf:in für unsere kantonale Kommunikationsstelle: Porträts, Veranstaltungen und Dokumentation. Fliessend Deutsch (C1) ist Voraussetzung: das Team, die Abläufe und alle Sitzungen sind auf Deutsch, Englisch genügt nicht. Mid-level, hybrid, Bern.

jobs.title: Photography Course Instructor
jobs.content: Teach our evening photography courses for adult beginners: exposure, composition and editing basics, two classes a week in our Zurich school. This is a teaching role, not a photographer position; no commercial shoots. On-site. The courses run in English; German is not required.

jobs.title: Account Manager, Camera Retail
jobs.content: Sell cameras and lenses to retail partners across the DACH region and manage the relationships and targets. Sales experience required.

jobs.title: Senior Photographer, Fashion & Lifestyle
jobs.content: Senior photographer for campaigns of a Geneva fashion house: lookbooks, editorials and e-commerce, with studio and location work. Hybrid. English is our working language; French is a plus for contact with the Geneva ateliers.

jobs.title: Real Estate Photographer
jobs.content: Photograph apartments and houses across the canton of Zurich for our property portal: interiors, exteriors and drone views, edit in Lightroom. Three years of experience wanted. On-site at the properties, with your own car. Salary CHF 72,000 – 82,000 per year. English or German.

jobs.title: Senior Photo & Video Producer
jobs.content: Senior producer for our brand content: plan, shoot and edit photo and video campaigns with studio lighting, Lightroom and Photoshop, working with a small team across Switzerland. Fully remote within Switzerland, with travel to shoots. English is the working language; German is a plus.

jobs.title: Head of Photography
jobs.content: Lead our six photographers and the studio: planning, quality and budgets, plus some shoots yourself. Management role. Hybrid. The team works in English; German is not required.

jobs.title: Senior Photographer, E-Commerce Studio
jobs.content: Run the shoots of our fashion and home e-commerce studio: about 150 products a day with studio lighting, Capture One tethering and Photoshop retouching to our style guide. Senior role, six or more years of professional product or fashion photography. On-site in our Zurich studio, five days a week. English is our working language; German is helpful. Salary CHF 92,000 – 108,000 per year plus 13th month.
